games.title: Invoice Ghost Zapper
games.tagline: Draw the right action to clear bills before they hit the ledger.
games.teaches: Ramp's AP agents sort real invoices from fraud and duplicates, so finance only touches the exceptions.
games.mechanicLabel: Match the right action under waves
games.closingStat: Ramp AP Agents cleared {score} bills while finance only touched the exceptions.

source.excerpt: Ramp's AI agents sort real invoices from fraud and duplicates, code line items into buckets, and route bills for approval under time pressure.

games.title: Cashback Cricket
games.tagline: Swing on the due date and send every eligible bill for cashback.
games.teaches: Ramp auto-pays card-eligible invoices right on their due date, so every eligible bill earns cashback instead of leaving money on the table.
games.closingStat: You captured {score} cashback points by paying right on time.

source.excerpt: Ramp automatically pays card-eligible invoices on their due date so every eligible bill earns cashback — pay inside the window without paying early.

games.title: Ramp Express: Scope Sprint
games.tagline: Catch the exact charge your agent card was made for — dodge everything else.
games.teaches: Ramp issues scoped, single-purpose agent cards that only work for the exact charge they were created for; everything off-scope is a risk.
games.closingStat: You safely captured {score} scoped charges without blowing the budget.

source.excerpt: Ramp issues scoped, single-purpose agent cards — collect the legitimate scoped charges and dodge open cards, duplicates, fakes, and expired tokens.
